scenarios.name: Async embeddings retain language and query behavior
scenarios.given: an on-device embedder suspends while producing passage and query vectors
scenarios.when: a conversation with a known transcription language is indexed and searched
scenarios.then: language metadata reaches the embedder and semantic search and Ask retrieval remain usable

scenarios.name: Deletion wins over suspended indexing
scenarios.given: a new conversation is awaiting a passage embedding
scenarios.when: that conversation is deleted before inference completes
scenarios.then: late work writes no vector file and neither lexical nor semantic results expose its text

scenarios.name: Clear history revokes pending conversations
scenarios.given: an archive snapshot has a held conversation and a later unvisited conversation
scenarios.when: history is cleared before inference completes
scenarios.then: neither known old conversation can return from late work or a stale retry, while a newly saved conversation can be indexed

scenarios.name: Cancellation cannot publish a partial conversation
scenarios.given: one passage is embedded and a second passage is awaiting inference
scenarios.when: the indexing task is cancelled and inference then finishes
scenarios.then: no partial vector record publishes and a later uncancelled save can succeed

scenarios.name: A later save wins over older inference
scenarios.given: an earlier version of a conversation is awaiting inference
scenarios.when: a newer version is saved before the old inference finishes
scenarios.then: only the newer version remains indexed and retrievable

scenarios.name: Rebuild supersedes an old sync
scenarios.given: a sync is awaiting an old conversation embedding
scenarios.when: the index is rebuilt from the current archive before old inference finishes
scenarios.then: the old sync cannot restore removed content or overwrite the rebuilt index

scenarios.name: Late queries cannot return deleted text
scenarios.given: a semantic search or Ask retrieval is awaiting its query embedding
scenarios.when: its conversation is deleted or cleared while the query is suspended
scenarios.then: the resumed request returns no stale conversation text or passage

scenarios.name: Cancelled queries publish no results
scenarios.given: a search or Ask retrieval is awaiting a query embedding
scenarios.when: the request is cancelled before inference completes
scenarios.then: late inference produces no lexical or semantic result or Ask passage

scenarios.name: Changing backend revokes old inference
scenarios.given: a conversation is awaiting the old embedding backend
scenarios.when: the backend is atomically replaced on the same index and current records are synced
scenarios.then: late old inference cannot restore or overwrite new-backend vectors

scenarios.name: Backend failure preserves coherent ownership
scenarios.given: an indexed conversation has valid vectors
scenarios.when: the same backend is selected or storage prevents switching to another backend
scenarios.then: same-signature selection preserves vectors and a failed switch retains the prior usable backend

scenarios.name: Old archive snapshots cannot overwrite later saves
scenarios.given: a multi-conversation sync is suspended before visiting a later conversation
scenarios.when: that later conversation is saved or a newer archive snapshot is synced before old inference finishes
scenarios.then: the newer vectors remain current and the older snapshot cannot restore or overwrite them

scenarios.name: A cancelled backend selection cannot change the current index
scenarios.given: the current backend has valid indexed conversations
scenarios.when: a backend-selection task is cancelled before the index actor handles it
scenarios.then: the current backend and its stored vectors remain unchanged and the cancelled choice is refused
